title: Middleware Execution Order
diagramContent:
graph TD
  Start[Incoming Request] --> M1[app.use(express.json)]
  M1 --> M2[app.use(cors)]
  M2 --> Route[app.get('/api/data')]
  Route --> End[res.send()]
  Route -.-> M3[app.use(ErrorHandler)]
  
  style Route fill:#4285f4,stroke:#fff,color:#fff
  style M3 fill:#ea4335,stroke:#fff,color:#fff
definition: In Express, the order in which you define your middleware matters immensely. Middleware functions are executed sequentially in the exact top-to-bottom order they are declared in your code. If you place a logger middleware *after* a route handler that sends a response, the logger will never run.
